input.quote: A. By Customer. Customer shall indemnify M&I from, and defend M&I against, any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) the inaccuracy or untruthfulness of any representation or warranty made by Customer to M&I, (ii) a violation of Federal, state, or other laws or regulations for the protection of persons or members of a protected class or category of persons by Customer or its employees or agents,
input.rationale: Section 14.2(B) already gives us a third-party IP infringement indemnity from M&I and 14.3 supplies notice, control-of-defence and cooperation procedures, so the rule is not missing. However the bargain fails the checklist on material terms in both directions: M&I's indemnity runs only to Customer (not our affiliates) and does not reach M&I's violation of applicable law generally (only protected-class laws), M&I-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of our data, or M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; while our own indemnity at 14.2(A) is sweeping (representations, protected-class laws, harassment, injury, property/financial loss from our acts or omissions, and Section 6.6(B) matters) rather than limited to content we supply and our own breach of law. We therefore proposed the shortest preferred-level cure: one new Paragraph C extending M&I's indemnity/defence to our affiliates and to the three missing conduct categories, and a narrowing of 14.2(A). Note (not separately flagged here) that Section 13.4 caps M&I's total liability at three months' payments, which the liability rule addresses; the fallback's 3x-annual-fees super-cap is accordingly not pursued under this rule.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
mappings.quote: any claim by a third party that the Services or M&I's software infringe upon any United States patent, copyright or trademark of a third party

mappings.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
mappings.quote: such indemnitee shall give notice of such claim to the indemnifying party, including a brief description of the amount and basis therefor, if known

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
mappings.quote: shall be entitled to assume control of the defense of the claim with counsel chosen by the indemnifying party, reasonably satisfactory to the indemnitee

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
mappings.quote: Indemnitee shall cooperate fully with, and assist, the indemnifying party in its defense against such claim in all reasonable respects.

mappings.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

proposal.summary: Extend M&I's indemnity to Customer affiliates and to M&I's breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; narrow Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended M&I's indemnity and defense to our affiliates and to M&I's violation of applicable law, M&I-caused unauthorized access to our data, and M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and we narrowed our own indemnity to content we supply and our own violations of law, consistent with our indemnity playbook position. The existing IP indemnity and Section 14.3 notice, control and cooperation procedures are unchanged.

ops.text: C. M&I's indemnity and defense obligations under Paragraph B shall also run to Customer's affiliates, and shall further extend to any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) M&I's violation of applicable law, (ii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer's data caused by M&I, and (iii) M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

ops.oldText: any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) the inaccuracy or untruthfulness of any representation or warranty made by Customer to M&I, (ii) a violation of Federal, state, or other laws or regulations for the protection of persons or members of a protected class or category of persons by Customer or its employees or agents, (iii) sexual discrimination or harassment by Customer or its employees or agents, (iv) work-related injury or death caused by Customer or its employees or agents, (v) tangible personal or real property damage or financial or monetary loss incurred by M&I resulting from Customer's acts or omissions, or those of its employees or agents and (vi) those matters included in Section 6.6(B) above.
ops.newText: any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) content, data, or materials provided by Customer to M&I and (ii) Customer's violation of applicable law.
